whyThisMatters:
No-code lead funnel builder: branching qualification on a visual canvas with scoring, verification, analytics and CRM handoff, pitched at marketers, agencies and service businesses (HVAC, solar, med spa templates). Starter 49 dollars a month, Pro 99 dollars a month, Scale 199 dollars a month. Founded Jul 2025, US. 142 active subscriptions.

Forms that qualify leads for home-service businesses. 142 paying subs at 49 dollars+ is a real base. But the history has a lifetime-deal-shaped spike.

You draw the questions. The form scores the lead and hands it to the system you already use. The templates are for home trades and clinics. The company is in the US and is young. The subscription count is a real base. The cash right after launch was much higher than the months since, which fits a launch spike more than a steady seat.

One trade, one country, and a form that pushes the lead into the tool they already pay for, is the smaller version of this.
